note: City of Owen campground in Crowley Park, beside Mill Pond Park (Clark County): one loop of sites around the shower house, mostly open and flat, with a rail line along the park's east side. --Claude
summary: Old city site is gone (cityofowen.com no longer answers; 'Website No Longer Available' 2026-10-16) and the city's new cityofowenwi.gov has no campground page; read the city page as captured 2026-07-12 plus its campground map: $18/night with electric and water ($120/week), 11 sites (30 A, 50 A on sites 1, 8, 10), coin showers, dump, FCFS with an optional reservation form. Not waterfront kept. Count 11 replaces the inclusion evidence's 28.
flags: WEBSITE: https://www.cityofowen.com/content/departments/crowley-campground-mill-pond-park is dead - the host refuses connections (2026-11-16) and showed 'Website No Longer Available' on 2026-10-16. The city moved to https://cityofowenwi.gov/ (2026 agendas/minutes are there), whose Parks & Recreation and Park Facilities pages say nothing about the campground. No current official campground page exists; suggest website -> https://cityofowenwi.gov/parks-and-recreation (city parks page) for want of better, or leave it and accept a dead link. PRESENCE (local, not a price-gate case): Google Maps 'Crowley Park' 3.5 from 2 reviews, no phone on the listing; the city's public reservation calendar still answers but its newest booking is June 2024.

SITES: inclusion_evidence says '28 sites with 30/50A electric/water/sewer'; the city map lists 11 sites (#1-#11) with 20/30 A, three with 50 A, and an RV dump station - no sewer at the sites is stated. Count 11 written; sewer left unset.
NIGHTLY USE: the city calendar shows ordinary 1-7 night reservations (2021-2024), one longer (site 6, June 14-July 31 2021); no seasonal-lease pattern. Weekly rate $120.
SEASON: only the 2020 city flyer gives one ('Opens May - Oct 15th'); not written (6 years old). Park hours 7 am-10 pm on the city page; the campground rules close the parks to non-campers 11 pm-6 am.
PHONE 715-229-2404 (City Hall) confirmed on the city page; police non-emergency 715-229-2161.

PIN: stored 44.9468,-90.5605 is ~40 m from the campground loop around the shower house (~44.9466,-90.5603 on Esri imagery). Fine. NOT WATERFRONT confirmed: the river and mill pond lie 150 m+ south and southwest behind woods.
NAME: the city calls it 'Crowley Park Campground' / 'Crowley Campground'.
